strings.subtitle: — Burburiyaha faylalka —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Jiidista iyo dhigista lama heli karo. Isticmaal badhanka hoose.
strings.shred_button: B U R B U R I
strings.ssd_warning:
Digniin! SSD-yada, habka dib-u-qoris ma dammaanad qaadanayo burburinta sababo la xiriira TRIM.
Barnaamijkani waa HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faylka "{name}" waa la dib-u-qori doonaa oo la tirtiri doonaa.

Sii wad?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Kani waa gaabin (.lnk). Kaliya gaabinta lafteeda ayaa la burburin doonaa.

Faylka bartilmaameedka ah ee uu tilmaamayo wuu sii ahaan doonaa mid sugan.

Sii wad?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Kani waa network drive (\\server\share).
Qorista sector-ka dammaanad kama qaadanayso burburin — server-ku wuxuu yeelan karaa snapshots, deduplication ama CoW.

Sii wad?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Kani waa removable drive (USB / HDD dibadda).
Kontaroolaha ayaa laga yaabaa inuu kaydiyo blocks hore.

Sii wad?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAYLKA WAA LA DIB-U-QORAY OO LA TIRTIRAY
strings.report_limits:
• Qulqulka xogta beddelka NTFS (ADS) lama shaqeeyo.
• Joornaalka USN lama nadiifiyo.
• Nuqullada hooska iyo isku-xirka daruuraha
  (OneDrive iwm.) lama saameeyaan.
strings.status_full: Nuxurka si buuxda ayaa loogu qoray eber. Soo-celinta lama suurtagelin — qalabku wuxuu arki doonaa oo keliya eber.
strings.status_fast: Madaxa, dabada iyo xariijimaha 4 MB waa la dib-u-qoray. Inta kale lama taaban, laakiin sababo la xiriira nusqaamaha, soo-celinta buuxda ee qalabka macaamiisha waa lama suurtagelin. Dukumentiyada qarsoodiga ah isticmaal qaybta BUUXA.
strings.status_empty: Faylku madhan yahay, dib-u-qoris lama baahna. La tirtiray.
strings.error_permission: Lama geli karo faylka. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ku furan yahay barnaamij kale. Xir oo isku day mar kale.
strings.error_not_found: Faylka lama helin. Waxaa laga yaabaa in horay loo tirtiray.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kani waa symbolic link. Links-ka lama burburin karo — faylka bartilmaameedka ah wuu sii ahaan doonaa mid sugan.
strings.error_reparse: Kani waa faylka meelaynta (OneDrive ama la mid ah). Xogtiisu waxay ku kaydsan tahay daruuraha, ma aha disk-ga — waxba lagama burburin karo halkan.
strings.error_not_file: Kani maaha fayl (gale ama wax kale). Soo tuur fayl.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faylkani wuxuu leeyahay hard links kale ({n} guud). Hard links ma laha mid koowaad — dhammaan magacyadu waa siman yihiin. Haddii aad ku burburiso wadada hadda, xogta waa la dul qori doonaa oo laga gooyn doonaa 32 bytes, laakiin stub-ka ayaa laga heli doonaa links kale. Marka hore tirtir dhammaan links-ka.
strings.error_compressed:
Faylku waa la isku duubay, la sireeyay ama wuu yaraaday. Eber ku dul qorista dammaanad kama qaadanayso burburinta xogta hore sababtoo ah NTFS si kale ayay u kaydisaa.

Ka saar sifada: riix midig → Guryaha → Sare → ka saar calaamadda 'Isku duub' iyo/ama 'Siree'. Ka dib dib u socodsii SHREDDER.
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Waa la joojinayaa faylka hadda kadib...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} faylal waa la burburin doonaa.
Cabirka guud: {size}.

Hubi liiska ka hor inta aanad sii wadin.
Ficilkan dib looma celin karo.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Ka saar dhammaan {count} faylal safka?

Faylalka laftooda LAMA TAABAN DOONO — kaliya liiska.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faylka "{name}" wuxuu leeyahay hard links kale ({nlink} guud).

Xogta waa la burburin doonaa dhammaan magacyada.
Laakiin hadhaaga (32 bytes) wuxuu ku sii nagaan doonaa magacyo kale gudaha galka.

Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u baahato inaad gacan ahaan u tirtirto hadhaagan.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Ku dhaqan dhammaan hard links-ka safka
